name: Tears Ahop gae, Yeol gae
source:
Tears - "Nine, ten" is a visual novel that tells the story of a girl with nine fingers and a boy with ten fingers. A story about our lives, human rights, laws, relationships, and dreams in the face of economic imbalances. Their short but intense encounters and stories will impress you a lot. 

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/776830/Tears__9_10/]Steam page[/url]]
translation:
《泪：九，十》是一部视觉小说，讲述一名只有九根手指的少女与一名拥有十根手指的少年的故事。在经济失衡的现实面前，作品探讨我们的生活、人权、法律、人际关系与梦想。他们短暂却强烈的相遇及其故事，将带给玩家深刻触动。

[内容取自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/776830/Tears__9_10/]Steam页面[/url]]
